headline: Core race engine is built and verified — the pace model, the record chase and course fairness are proved by headless tools, not asserted. The game is playable end to end at 60fps. Wave 1 of the builder/critic loop is now running on the five visual and feel pieces.

pieces.name: Pace & record model
pieces.verdict: Verified by tools/simulate.js against real courses
pieces.gap: Tuning is locked: flawless 1:58:16, one mistake 1:59:21, two mistakes 2:00:52

pieces.name: Course generation
pieces.gap: Difficulty curve has not been judged by a human — only proved fair

pieces.name: Collision & fairness
pieces.verdict: State thresholds audited against visual geometry at load
pieces.gap: Forgiveness windows never tuned against real play

pieces.name: Runner character
pieces.verdict: Head does not separate from torso from behind
pieces.gap: Reads as generic, not as a toy; run cycle never judged in motion

pieces.name: Cel-shading & sky
pieces.verdict: Sky dome shows banding arcs; outlines ignore fog
pieces.gap: No aerial perspective, so the world has no depth

pieces.name: World & obstacles
pieces.verdict: Hazards unreadable at distance; scenery is placeholder
pieces.gap: Six biomes differ only by colour tint, not by content

pieces.name: Camera & speed feel
pieces.verdict: Framing too far out; speed reads as constant
pieces.gap: The honest 21% pace gain does not feel like another gear

pieces.name: HUD & typography
pieces.verdict: Broadcast styling works; information hierarchy misleads
pieces.gap: A flawless run is shown a huge red deficit while actually on record pace

pieces.name: Controls & game feel
pieces.verdict: Buffering and swipe implemented, never play-tested
pieces.gap: No human has played it yet

pieces.name: Audio
pieces.verdict: Procedural mix written, never listened to
pieces.gap: Cannot be verified by screenshot — needs a different check
